# Preserved shadcn styles

Copied byte-for-byte from shadcn 4.13.1 dist/tailwind.css before removing the development CLI dependency. Original CSS SHA-256: `bc7d83425702955b4cb67cb14ede9d603f9d912376d57a2d81d661094d2a782a`. The adjacent MIT license is preserved. The stylesheet was subsequently formatted with Prettier. Canonical CSS parser/formatter output is identical to the original, and all seven responsive browser matrices pass.
